theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (C : NNReal), 0 < p → (∀ w : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 w → HasCompactSupport w → ∫⁻ x, ‖w x‖ₑ ^ p ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * (∫⁻ x, ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ₑ) ^ p) → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 w → HasCompactSupport w → (∫ z, |w z| ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ ≤ c * ∫ z, ‖fderiv ℝ w z‖
